quarterly_data.signal: Lam's June 2026 quarter earnings release states its deferred revenue balance does not include shipments to customers in Japan, to whom title does not transfer until customer acceptance; these shipments are classified as inventory at cost until acceptance. The estimated future revenue from shipments to customers in Japan was approximately $490.2 million as of June 28, 2026, versus $434.3 million as of March 29, 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: estimated future revenue from Japan shipments ~$490.2 million (June 28, 2026) vs $434.3 million (March 29, 2026)

quarterly_data.signal: The release's revenue disaggregation table (in thousands) shows systems revenue of $4,249,848 for the three months ended June 28, 2026 versus $3,437,625 for the three months ended June 29, 2025, and customer support-related revenue and other of $1,733,768 in the June 2025 quarter. Systems revenue includes new leading-edge deposition, etch and other wafer fabrication equipment; customer support-related revenue includes service, spares, upgrades and non-leading-edge Reliant equipment.
